title: StockSmart Demand Planning Note — Spread of Billed Months and Safety Units in a Converted Bin's Reorder Point
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — customer-owned reorder point of a bin converted from consignment at a par review.**

**Rule.** The converted item's safety units follow the spread of its billed months: where its largest single billing month of consumption on record is 1.5 times its average billed month or more (its consumption of the last twelve months divided by the number of those months that billed it), the safety units are the difference between the largest month and the average billed month, multiplied by the standard days and then divided by 30; where the largest month is 1.2 times the average billed month or more but less than 1.5 times, the safety units are half (0.5 times) of the product of the daily draw and the standard days; an item with steadier months, or with no consumption billed in the last twelve months, takes no safety units.

**Terms used by the rule.** The billed months are the program's monthly consumption billing lines for the item; the last twelve months are the lines of age below twelve, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month. The largest month is taken from every line on record. The daily draw is the item's consumption billed over the last twelve months divided by 365. The standard days are the visit gap, 30 days divided by the visits the program's tier schedules a month (7 days for a tier scheduling none), plus the tier's replenishment lead business days.

### Hypothetical item: 120 units billed over 4 months of the last twelve (average billed month 30), standard days 10

| Largest month on record | Ratio to the average | Branch | Safety units |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60 | 2.0 | 1.5 or more | 60 less 30 is 30; times 10 is 300; divided by 30: 10 |
| 45 | exactly 1.5 | 1.5 or more | 15 times 10, divided by 30: 5 |
| 40 | 1.333333 | 1.2 or more, below 1.5 | daily draw 0.328767 times 10 is 3.287671; half: 1.643836 |
| 36 | exactly 1.2 | 1.2 or more, below 1.5 | half of 3.287671: 1.643836 |
| 33 | 1.1 | steadier | none |

An item with no consumption billed in the last twelve months takes no safety units.
